title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named UNH spaces for studying, meeting, making media, playing games, or taking a quiet break between classes.

cards.title: Hubbard Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Dimond Library, Level 3
cards.notes: Use this designated quiet area for individual reading or focused work; keep calls and audible devices outside the space.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet-study room on Dimond Library’s main floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UNH Libraries lists the Hubbard Reading Room on Dimond Library Level 3 as a designated quiet space for individual study.
cards.source_title: Spaces to Study & Work | UNH Library
cards.access_notes: Follow current Dimond Library access rules and quiet-area expectations.

cards.title: Addison Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Dimond Library, Level 3
cards.notes: Bring a solo task and use the designated quiet setting; move conversations or phone calls to an approved area.
cards.short_summary: A second named quiet-study room on Dimond’s main floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UNH Libraries identifies the Addison Reading Room on Dimond Library Level 3 as a designated quiet area for individual study.
cards.source_title: Spaces to Study & Work | UNH Library
cards.access_notes: Follow current Dimond Library access rules and quiet-area expectations.

cards.title: Courtyard Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Dimond Library, Level 5
cards.notes: Head to Level 5 when you need a designated quiet-study setting and can work independently without conversation.
cards.short_summary: A named Level 5 quiet space inside Dimond Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UNH Libraries lists the Courtyard Reading Room on Dimond Library Level 5 among its designated quiet spaces.
cards.source_title: Spaces to Study & Work | UNH Library
cards.access_notes: Follow current Dimond Library access rules and quiet-area expectations.

cards.title: Parker Media Lab
cards.subtitle: Dimond Library, Room 257
cards.notes: Plan a media-focused work session here; confirm current equipment availability or assistance needs with library staff first.
cards.short_summary: A named media-work destination on Dimond Library’s second level.
cards.evidence_claim: UNH Libraries lists Parker Media Lab, Room 257, on Level 2 of Dimond Library.
cards.access_notes: Check current library access and any equipment-use requirements before visiting.

cards.title: Studio 235
cards.subtitle: Dimond Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Use the library floor listing to locate this named studio, then check locally for current setup and availability.
cards.short_summary: A named studio destination on Dimond Library’s second level.
cards.evidence_claim: UNH Libraries lists Studio 235 on Level 2 of Dimond Library.
cards.access_notes: Check current library access and room-use requirements before visiting.

cards.title: Games Room
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union Building, Room 154A
cards.notes: Meet a friend for billiards, table tennis, or video games in Room 154A; verify the room’s current availability on arrival.
cards.short_summary: A named MUB room for casual table and video games.
cards.evidence_claim: UNH’s MUB venues page says the Games Room in Room 154A offers billiards, table tennis, and video games.
cards.source_title: Venues & Services | Memorial Union & Student Activities
cards.access_notes: Room availability may vary with MUB operations and scheduled use.

cards.title: Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union Building, first floor
cards.notes: Commuting students can use the couches, tables, whiteboard, and charging station during regular MUB hours.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor MUB multipurpose lounge for commuting students.
cards.evidence_claim: UNH states that its first-floor MUB Commuter Lounge provides commuters with couches, tables, chairs, a whiteboard, and a charging station.
cards.access_notes: Specified for commuters and available during regular MUB hours.

cards.title: Commuter Kitchenette
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union Building, first floor
cards.notes: Commuting students can stop in to use the fridge or microwave and make space for lunch during regular MUB hours.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor MUB kitchenette for commuting students.
cards.evidence_claim: UNH says the first-floor MUB Commuter Kitchenette offers commuters a fridge, microwave, and a place to eat lunch.
cards.access_notes: Specified for commuters and available during regular MUB hours.

cards.title: Interfaith Prayer & Meditation Room
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union Building
cards.notes: Use this inclusive room for quiet prayer, contemplation, meditation, reflection, or personal practice; preserve its calm purpose.
cards.short_summary: A named MUB space for quiet reflection and practice.
cards.evidence_claim: UNH describes the MUB Interfaith Prayer & Meditation Room as an inclusive space for quiet prayer, contemplation, meditation, reflection, and practice.
cards.source_title: Venues & Services | Memorial Union & Student Activities
cards.access_notes: Use respectfully and confirm current MUB building access before visiting.

cards.title: Union Court
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union Building
cards.notes: Choose a table here to meet between classes or pair a meal stop with a conversation; check current dining operations separately.
cards.short_summary: A named MUB gathering and dining area.
cards.evidence_claim: UNH’s MUB venues page identifies Union Court as a place to eat or hang out with friends.
cards.source_title: Venues & Services | Memorial Union & Student Activities
cards.access_notes: Food purchases may be required for dining; seating and operations can vary.
